description: OpenAI-compatible speech-to-text (Whisper) — Drop-in OpenAI Audio Transcriptions API: multipart/form-data with a file field (mp3, wav, m4a, ogg, webm; max 3 MB) exactly like client.audio.transcriptions.create, or a JSON body {url} pointing at an audio file.
